result.narrative:
Emberline Electricals Ltd scores 37.2 and sits in the Watch band, with a PD of 0.2718 against a portfolio target of 0.25. The exposure is all with one client, Adlerhof Trade Credit (CL01): six open invoices totalling roughly €324.7k, of which INV000379 at €65,400 is 32 days past due and the remaining five, around €259k, are open but not yet due. There is no settled payment history at all, so the trend is recorded as insufficient_history and the 32 DPD reading has no baseline. Two adverse articles sit on file, both pointing the same way.

The band is driven by payment: 0.65 x 44.0 (payment, 32 DPD) + 0.35 x 24.5 (news) = 37.2, so 28.6 of the score comes from lateness and 8.6 from news. The adjudicator agreed with the band but attached caveats and asked that the file be treated as the weak end of Watch rather than a marginal pass. Four things the formula does not capture all push upward: open exposure of €324.7k exceeds the €300k CL01 limit, there is no settled history to benchmark the 32 DPD against, the payment snapshot of 2026-08-24 predates the as-of date implied by the news age_days, and the more recent NWS0011 is excluded because only the top-severity article scores. The adjudicator also noted the payment review contradicts itself, describing the exposure as "close to" the €300k limit in its summary while its own concerns list states it exceeds it.

The recommended action is FREEZE on LIM0010: the limit stays at €300,000, change 0, on the grounds that the buyer is already owed at or above the limit and there is nothing left to cut. Expected loss is 66047 before and after, so the freeze contains further drawdown rather than reducing existing risk. Before relying on the score, the adjudicator recommends pulling a current aged-debt position and re-underwriting the line, which was last reviewed in Nov 2024 and predates the current overdue balance. Confirming the identity behind NWS0011 is also worth doing, as it names "Emberline Inds." and appears matched on the Coventry location and Electrical Equipment segment rather than legal name.

To move down to Healthy the score needs to fall below 35.0, which is 2.2 points away and well within reach if INV000379 settles and the remaining €259k is paid to terms, establishing the settlement history the file currently lacks. Bringing total exposure back under the €300k limit would remove the breach. On the downside, High Risk begins at 60.0, 22.8 points up, reachable at 50 DPD on the worst line; news alone does not hold the band, and the news component decays on a 365-day half-life.

judgement.bottom_line: Freeze LIM0010 at €300,000 (no change): open exposure of €324.7k already exceeds the limit, so there is nothing left to cut, and a 32 DPD line plus vendor payment-delay reporting hold the buyer in Watch at 37.2. The adjudicator agreed with the band but added caveats — treat this as the weak end of Watch and pull a current aged-debt position and re-underwrite the Nov 2024 line before relying on the score.
